messages:
anya: heads up — the eval-runner started spiking retries on the new llama-8q quant runs. CI showed a bunch of duplicate evals and our metrics look off :frowning:
mike: saw that too. queue length climbed to ~1200 and workers kept re-picking the same shard. looks like lease expiration isn't being propagated to the scheduler.
sophia: can you paste the relevant logs? I want to check the lease timestamps and the retry backoff behaviour.
anya: pasted snippets from the runner logs below:
```
[2024-11-09T14:22:10Z] INFO shard=42 lease_acquired expires_at=2024-11-09T14:22:30Z worker=runner-17
[2024-11-09T14:22:31Z] WARN shard=42 lease_expired worker=runner-17
[2024-11-09T14:22:31Z] INFO shard=42 retry enqueued attempt=2
[2024-11-09T14:22:31Z] INFO shard=42 lease_acquired expires_at=2024-11-09T14:22:51Z worker=runner-5
```
anya: note how attempt=2 is enqueued immediately after lease_expired — but no jitter/backoff, so multiple workers race and we get duplicated eval runs.
mike: ahhh that matches the spike. Our retry policy currently does exponential but the scheduler bypasses it when it sees a lease_expired event. i'll add a small safety backoff there.
jason: also the shard assignment index isn't idempotent — if two workers call `claim_shard()` at the same time the DB write can lose the lease flag and both think they own it. we should move to a compare-and-set (CAS) update for shard state.
sophia: +1 on CAS. we should also add a metric gauge for "shard_in_flight_duplicates" and an alert when duplicates/sec > 1 for 5m. dashboards don't show this today.
anya: quick patch i sketched for the scheduler (pseudo):
```
// claim_shard pseudo
if db.compare_and_set(shard_id, {state: 'idle'}, {state: 'locked', owner: worker_id, lease_expires: t}) {
  return true
} else {
  return false
}
```
mike: looks good. i'll send a follow-up to ensure we still support explicit lease_steal for prioritized jobs.
sophia: CI is flaking because the eval-harness e2e tries to assert exact counts on completed evals. if duplicates happen the golden counts fail. we should make the test tolerant to ">= expected" for now and add a follow-up to assert dedup behavior.
ci-bot: CI Workflow #5821 failed: https://ci.internal.redwood/flows/5821 — test: eval_harness/integration::quant_run_check — failing assertion: expected 100, got 103
eval-bot: recorded anomaly: metric=shard_retry_rate value=12.3 window=5m tags=[model:llama-8q,env:staging]
jason: another root cause — the queue re-enqueue path doesn't set `backoff_until` when a lease expiry triggers a re-enqueue. so even if we add jitter elsewhere, re-enqueue will keep being immediate. fixing that too.
anya: plan proposal:
- short term (hotfix): make e2e tolerant (>=) and add scheduler safety backoff for lease_expired path (5s jitter)
- mid term: implement CAS on claim_shard, set backoff_until on re-enqueue, add metric + alert
- long term: add a per-shard dedup id (run_id) and deterministic deduper in the reporting pipeline (so dashboards/CI read deduped counts)
mike: i'll open two PRs: scheduler-hotfix and CAS-claim. target hotfix for today, CAS in the next sprint.
sophia: i'll add the `shard_in_flight_duplicates` gauge to the harness metrics exporter and a Grafana panel. also wire an alert:
```
alert: ShardDuplicateSpike
expr: increase(shard_in_flight_duplicates[5m]) / 300 > 0.003
for: 5m
```
anya: can someone update the eval-harness CI to record the `run_id` in the e2e logs? that will make repro and postmortem easier.
jason: yes, i'll add `run_id` to the runner trace and to the reporting payload.
mike: PR links:
- scheduler hotfix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/412
- CAS claim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/413 (draft)
anya: thanks. after hotfix lands i'll re-run the failing CI job and post results here.
ci-bot: CI Workflow #5826 started: https://ci.internal.redwood/flows/5826 — running eval_harness/integration::quant_run_check
ci-bot: CI Workflow #5826 passed ✅
anya: re-run passed. metrics now show duplicates dropped to near 0. still keeping CAS patch in review.
mike: follow-up: we should add a small e2e that intentionally induces lease expiration and asserts no duplicate completed jobs. i'll add that to the harness test matrix.
sophia: logging note — include `owner` and `attempt` in the standard structured log fields so it's easy to query in Loki.
anya: good catch. closing the loop — created an internal postmortem draft and added action items to infra board. thanks everyone :rocket:
